title: The Vector of New Lagos Anew
author: Orsen Nystrom
blurb: Rosalind Villalobos, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
